sources.title: Recent advances in the phencyclidine model of schizophrenia
sources.relevance: NMDAR hypofunction hypothesis origin; PCP model produces both positive and cognitive symptoms of SCZ

sources.title: Gene expression deficits in a subclass of GABA neurons in the prefrontal cortex of subjects with schizophrenia
sources.relevance: Core postmortem evidence: GAD67/PV mRNA reduced in ~45% of PV+ neurons in DLPFC; cell count unchanged

sources.title: Relationship of brain-derived neurotrophic factor and its receptor TrkB to altered inhibitory prefrontal circuitry in schizophrenia
sources.relevance: BDNF/TrkB correlated with GAD67/PV reduction in SCZ DLPFC; links TrkB pathway to PV dysfunction

sources.title: Driving fast-spiking cells induces gamma rhythm and controls sensory responses
sources.relevance: Optogenetic causal evidence: activating PV/FS cells at specific frequency induces gamma rhythm

sources.title: Parvalbumin neurons and gamma rhythms enhance cortical circuit performance
sources.authors: Sohal VS, Zhang F, Yizhar O, Deisseroth K
sources.relevance: Optogenetic causal evidence: PV cells are necessary and sufficient for gamma; gamma enhances circuit signal/noise

sources.title: NMDA receptor hypofunction, parvalbumin-positive neurons, and cortical gamma oscillations in schizophrenia
sources.relevance: Key review: links NMDAR hypofunction → PV dysfunction → gamma deficits → cognitive symptoms in SCZ; raises key constraint about NMDAR direct role in mature PV cells

sources.title: The role of glutamatergic inputs onto parvalbumin-positive interneurons: relevance for schizophrenia
sources.relevance: Questions whether NMDAR antagonism directly affects mature PV neurons; proposes cortical disinhibition via alternative mechanisms

sources.title: Deficits in transcriptional regulators of cortical parvalbumin neurons in schizophrenia
sources.relevance: Lhx6 (MGE fate TF) also reduced in SCZ DLPFC, along with PV/SST/GAD67; suggests developmental origin

sources.title: GABA level, gamma oscillation, and working memory performance in schizophrenia
sources.relevance: GABA levels correlate with gamma amplitude in SCZ; reduced gamma during WM tasks

sources.title: Alterations in cortical network oscillations and parvalbumin neurons in schizophrenia
sources.authors: Gonzalez-Burgos G, Cho RY, Lewis DA
sources.relevance: Comprehensive review: SCZ gamma power reduced in DLPFC during cognitive tasks; PV basket cell GAD67 loss; two competing mechanistic models (intrinsic PV vs. pyramidal driver)

sources.title: Impaired theta-gamma coupling during working memory performance in schizophrenia
sources.relevance: SCZ patients show selectively impaired theta-gamma coupling during WM; coupling correlates with task accuracy

sources.title: NMDA-receptor inhibition and oxidative stress during hippocampal maturation differentially alter parvalbumin expression and gamma-band activity
sources.relevance: NMDAR inhibition + oxidative stress synergistically reduce PV expression; separate pathological mechanisms

sources.title: NMDA receptors on parvalbumin-positive interneurons and pyramidal neurons both contribute to MK-801 induced gamma oscillatory disturbances
sources.relevance: Both PV interneurons and pyramidal neurons contribute to MK-801 gamma disruption; complex relationships

sources.title: GSK3β inhibition restores cortical gamma oscillation and cognitive behavior in a mouse model of NMDA receptor hypofunction relevant to schizophrenia
sources.relevance: GSK3β inhibition restores synchronous GABA release, spike firing, and evoked gamma in NMDAR hypofunction SCZ model

sources.title: Early NMDA receptor ablation in interneurons causes an activity-dependent E/I imbalance in PFC pyramidal neurons of a schizophrenia model
sources.relevance: PV-specific NMDAR KO → E/I imbalance in PFC pyramidal neurons; confirms direct PV-NMDAR contribution

sources.title: Potassium channel modulators and schizophrenia: an overview of investigational drugs
sources.relevance: Kv3.1/3.2 channel modulators (AUT00206) as therapeutic approach targeting PV cell fast-spiking capacity in SCZ

sources.title: Targeting frontal gamma activity with neurofeedback to improve working memory in schizophrenia
sources.relevance: EEG gamma neurofeedback to improve WM in SCZ; gamma as therapeutic target

sources.title: Global Grin2a loss causes divergent impairments to PV+ and SST+ interneurons and alters gamma oscillations in prefrontal cortex
sources.relevance: GluN2A-specific PV vulnerability: GluN2A KO selectively impairs PV+ cells while enhancing SST+; gamma power altered in PFC

sources.title: Clozapine induces perineuronal net remodeling in a developmental mouse model exhibiting schizophrenia-relevant phenotypes
sources.relevance: Clozapine restores PNN microarchitecture in SCZ model; antipsychotic effects involve extracellular matrix remodeling around PV cells
